description: This file contains implementation of custom autograd functions and forward mode automatic differentiation utilities in PyTorch, including functions for processing forward mode AD, managing autograd context, and handling tensor views and inplace modifications.

classes.name: AutogradContext
classes.description: Manages saved variables, gradients, and metadata for autograd operations, including saving for backward, retrieving saved variables, and marking tensors as dirty or non-differentiable.

methods.name: _process_forward_mode_AD
methods.description: Processes forward mode automatic differentiation, computes forward gradients, and performs view and inplace operation checks.

methods.name: _process_backward_mode_ad
methods.description: Handles backward mode AD, sets up gradient functions and output metadata, and manages view and inplace constraints.

methods.name: _wrap_outputs
methods.description: Wraps raw outputs into autograd variables, performs backward mode and forward mode AD processing, and enforces constraints.

methods.name: check_variable_result
methods.description: Checks that tensor properties (type, device, size) are unchanged by hooks.
